intent: Stage new GitHub signals: release assets, stargazer and fork days, issues/PRs, package downloads, repo vitals

edits.new_content:
version: 2
sources:
- name: raw
  schema: raw
  tables:
  - name: repositories
  - name: traffic
  - name: observations
  - name: legacy
  - name: snapshots
  - name: discovery
  - name: releases
  - name: release_assets
  - name: signal_captures
  - name: stargazer_days
  - name: fork_days
  - name: issues
  - name: package_downloads

version: 2
models:
- name: dim_repository
  columns:
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: repository_identity
    description: Stable GitHub repository ID when available, otherwise its configured name.
  - name: source_revision
    description: Full immutable Git SHA used to import this repository history.
  - name: synced_at
    description: UTC time when the pinned source was imported; not a source event date.
  description: One row per configured repository.
- name: fct_traffic
  columns:
  - name: traffic_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: clones_total
    description: GitHub clone operations for this UTC day; not installations.
  - name: clones_unique
    description: Daily unique cloner observations; not distinct people over a period.
  - name: views_total
    description: GitHub page views for this UTC day; may include automation.
  - name: views_unique
    description: Daily unique visitor observations; not distinct people over a period.
  - name: observed_days
    description: One per observed repository-day; a coverage count, not an imputation.
  description: One row per repository and observed UTC date. Counts pass through from the source.
- name: fct_observations
  columns:
  - name: observation_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: observation_gap_days
    description: Days since the previous capture for this repository; null for its first capture.
  - name: stars_net_change
    description: Star balance difference only between consecutive captured UTC days; otherwise null.
  - name: forks_net_change
    description: Fork balance difference only between consecutive captured UTC days; otherwise null.
  description: Latest capture per repository and UTC date; daily changes require consecutive dates.
- name: fct_legacy
  columns:
  - name: legacy_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  description: One row per repository and historical source date; reconstructed balances carry forward
    within that repository.
- name: fct_referrer
  columns:
  - name: referrer_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: referrer
    description: Referring source ever reported in this repository endpoint.
  - name: views
    description: Reported views in one rolling snapshot window; null for an unreported item.
  - name: uniques
    description: Reported unique observations in one rolling snapshot; not additive across items.
  - name: reported_rank
    description: Rank among reported top-10 items; null if absent from the selected snapshot.
  - name: is_reported
    description: Whether this item was present in this exact successful snapshot; false is not zero traffic.
  description: One row per repository, latest daily referrer snapshot, and historically known referrer.
    Absent items retain null counts.
- name: fct_path
  columns:
  - name: path_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: path
    description: Repository path ever reported in this repository endpoint.
  - name: views
    description: Reported views in one rolling snapshot window; null for an unreported item.
  - name: uniques
    description: Reported unique observations in one rolling snapshot; not additive across items.
  - name: reported_rank
    description: Rank among reported top-10 items; null if absent from the selected snapshot.
  - name: is_reported
    description: Whether this item was present in this exact successful snapshot; false is not zero traffic.
  description: One row per repository, latest daily path snapshot, and historically known path. Absent
    items retain null counts.
- name: fct_snapshot_status
  columns:
  - name: snapshot_key
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: endpoint
    description: 'GitHub rolling snapshot endpoint: paths or referrers.'
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: source_file
    description: Original upstream snapshot filename for provenance.
  description: Latest successful snapshot per repository, endpoint, and UTC date; empty snapshots remain
    present.
- name: dim_event
  columns:
  - name: repository
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - relationships:
        arguments:
          to: ref('dim_repository')
          field: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: event_id
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: 'Stable source event identifier; manual annotations use the annotation: prefix in the
      event mart.'
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC event date used for association comparisons, not causal attribution.
  - name: kind
    description: Release or maintainer-supplied campaign/event category.
  - name: title
    description: Public release or annotation title.
  - name: url
    description: Optional public event URL; absence is valid.
  - name: prerelease
    description: Whether GitHub marks this release as a prerelease; false for manual annotations.
  description: One row per public release or annotated event. Comparisons establish association only.
- name: metricflow_time_spine
  time_spine:
    standard_granularity_column: date_day
  columns:
  - name: date_day
    granularity: day
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
    description: Continuous UTC day used by MetricFlow as its day-grain time spine.
  description: Continuous UTC calendar spanning the observed sources and a 28-day margin.
- name: stg_releases
  columns:
  - name: release_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: event_id
    description: 'Stable source event identifier; manual annotations use the annotation: prefix in the
      event mart.'
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC event date used for association comparisons, not causal attribution.
  - name: kind
    description: Release or maintainer-supplied campaign/event category.
  - name: title
    description: Public release or annotation title.
  - name: url
    description: Optional public event URL; absence is valid.
  - name: prerelease
    description: Whether GitHub marks this release as a prerelease; false for manual annotations.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 event_id. No deduplication or missing-date\
    \ imputation."
- name: stg_discovery
  columns:
  - name: discovery_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: endpoint
    description: 'GitHub rolling snapshot endpoint: paths or referrers.'
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: item
    description: Reported path or referrer within this endpoint capture; not a complete traffic census.
  - name: views
    description: Reported views in one rolling snapshot window; null for an unreported item.
  - name: uniques
    description: Reported unique observations in one rolling snapshot; not additive across items.
  - name: reported_rank
    description: Rank among reported top-10 items; null if absent from the selected snapshot.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 endpoint \xD7 captured_at \xD7 item.\
    \ No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_legacy
  columns:
  - name: legacy_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 date. No deduplication or missing-date\
    \ imputation."
- name: stg_observations
  columns:
  - name: observation_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: stars
    description: Repository star balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: forks
    description: Repository fork balance; reconstructed in legacy history, directly captured in observations.
  - name: watchers
    description: GitHub watcher (subscriber) count at capture; null for captures that predate the field.
  - name: open_issues_and_prs
    description: GitHub open_issues_count at capture, which includes open pull requests; null when not captured.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 captured_at. No deduplication or missing-date\
    \ imputation."
- name: stg_repositories
  columns:
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository_identity
    description: Stable GitHub repository ID when available, otherwise its configured name.
  - name: source_revision
    description: Full immutable Git SHA used to import this repository history.
  - name: synced_at
    description: UTC time when the pinned source was imported; not a source event date.
  description: Explicit source projection at grain repository. No deduplication or missing-date imputation.
- name: stg_snapshots
  columns:
  - name: snapshot_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: endpoint
    description: 'GitHub rolling snapshot endpoint: paths or referrers.'
  - name: captured_at
    description: Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection.
  - name: source_file
    description: Original upstream snapshot filename for provenance.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 endpoint \xD7 captured_at. No deduplication\
    \ or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_traffic
  columns:
  - name: traffic_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
  - name: date
    description: UTC observation date. Missing dates are absent evidence, never implied zeros.
  - name: clones_total
    description: GitHub clone operations for this UTC day; not installations.
  - name: clones_unique
    description: Daily unique cloner observations; not distinct people over a period.
  - name: views_total
    description: GitHub page views for this UTC day; may include automation.
  - name: views_unique
    description: Daily unique visitor observations; not distinct people over a period.
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \xD7 date. No deduplication or missing-date\
    \ imputation."
- name: stg_release_assets
  columns:
  - name: release_asset_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: event_id
    description: "Release event identifier shared with dim_event."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: asset_id
    description: "GitHub release asset ID."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: captured_at
    description: "Exact successful capture timestamp, normalized to UTC for daily selection."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: download_count
    description: "Cumulative asset downloads reported by GitHub at capture; not unique users."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 asset_id \u00d7 captured_at. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_signal_captures
  columns:
  - name: signal_capture_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: signal
    description: "Collected signal: stargazers, forks, issues, or registry:package for downloads."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: captured_at
    description: "Exact successful capture timestamp of the signal files."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: complete
    description: "False when GitHub pagination limits truncated the listing."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 signal. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_stargazer_days
  columns:
  - name: stargazer_day_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date
    description: "UTC day current stargazers starred the repository."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: stars
    description: "Current stargazers who starred on this day; unstarred users are absent."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 date. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_fork_days
  columns:
  - name: fork_day_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date
    description: "UTC day existing forks were created."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: forks
    description: "Existing direct forks created on this day; deleted forks are absent."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 date. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_issues
  columns:
  - name: issue_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: number
    description: "Issue or pull request number."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: kind
    description: "issue or pull_request."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values: ['issue', 'pull_request']
  - name: created_at
    description: "UTC creation timestamp."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: closed_at
    description: "UTC close timestamp; null while open."
  - name: merged_at
    description: "UTC merge timestamp for pull requests; null if unmerged."
  - name: author_association
    description: "GitHub author association, e.g. FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR; no identities are stored."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 number. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
- name: stg_package_downloads
  columns:
  - name: package_download_source_key
    description: Stable key for the complete declared row grain; not a person identifier.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: repository
    description: GitHub owner/repository name; required in every cross-project grain.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: registry
    description: "Package registry: pypi or npm."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values: ['pypi', 'npm']
  - name: package
    description: "Registry package name configured in sources.yml."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date
    description: "UTC download day as reported by the registry."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: downloads
    description: "Registry downloads for the day; PyPI excludes mirrors; both include CI and bots."
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  description: "Explicit source projection at grain repository \u00d7 registry \u00d7 package \u00d7 date. No deduplication or missing-date imputation."
